newsitem.title: FRANCE: PSA says product mix impact offset H1 forex gain.
newsitem.headline: PSA says product mix impact offset H1 forex gain.

text.p: French carmaker PSA Peugeot Citroen said on Wednesday that currency benefits registered in the first half of 1997, due largely to sterling's rise, were offset by a deterioration in the product and geographic mix.
The company said in a statement that consolidated first-half sales rose 6.3 percent to 94.64 billion francs, or 6.2 percent on a like for like basis.
Turnover in its main car-making activities was up 6.4 percent at 89.71 billion francs, or 6.3 percent on a like for like basis.

"The positive impact of currency changes was offset by a negative impact on the product and geographic mix," it said in its sales statement, as the proportion of larger cars sold declined. Also, in sales terms, its market share loss in France was not offset by gains in markets with weaker currencies.
